name: Juice Shop: SQL Injection Login Bypass
short_description: Bypass authentication in OWASP Juice Shop using SQL injection.
description: OWASP Juice Shop is a modern web application with 100+ security challenges. This lesson covers the classic SQL injection login bypass - one of the first challenges. You'll learn how improper input sanitization leads to authentication bypass.

steps.title: Open Juice Shop
steps.explanation: Juice Shop is a Node.js e-commerce application with intentional vulnerabilities.

steps.title: Test for SQL injection
steps.explanation: The single quote breaks the SQL query. 'OR 1=1' is always true. '--' comments out the rest.
steps.expected: Login fails but you might see an error revealing SQL is being used

steps.title: Bypass login as admin
steps.explanation: We're saying 'log me in as admin@juice-sh.op and ignore everything after'. The comment (--) skips password check.

steps.title: Alternative: Use any email format
steps.explanation: This bypasses as the first user in the database (usually admin).

steps.title: View the scoreboard
steps.explanation: Juice Shop tracks your progress. Check how many challenges you've solved.

steps.title: Use SQLMap for automated testing
steps.explanation: SQLMap can automatically detect and exploit SQL injection. Run this from Kali.

success_criteria: You logged in as admin without knowing the password. Check the Juice Shop scoreboard for credit.
next_steps: Try other Juice Shop challenges: XSS, broken access control, insecure deserialization
Try to access admin section at /administration
